subject: Pilot extension: temporary seat swap vs top-up voucher for NimbleCare
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@nimblecare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimblecare.com
Date: 2025-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension and interim access ask

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from procurement — the pilot team is seeing a burst in traffic with a product demo next Wednesday and we need short-term additional capacity. Budget is tight this quarter, so procurement asked if we could do either:

- A 2-week extension on the existing timeboxed pilot at no additional charge, or
- A short-term seat swap (2 temporary seats) or a top-up voucher ($3k) to cover the burst, billed as a one-off credit.

Can you confirm which options Redwood can support without legal redlines? We want to keep the momentum but need a clean procurement path.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Head of Platform Success — NimbleCare
[Attachment: NimbleCare_Pilot_Report_week2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and interim access ask

Hi Lina — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the demo. We can do two pragmatic pathways that avoid contract churn and are procurement-friendly:

Option A — temporary seat swap (preferred):
- We grant 2 additional seats for 14 days under the existing pilot scope.
- No changes to the SOW; seats auto-revoke after 14 days.
- We’ll send a one-line amendment for procurement to confirm (no legal signature required).

Option B — top-up voucher:
- One-off $3,000 voucher applied as a usage credit to cover the demo burst.
- Voucher redeemed in the billing portal; procurement receives an invoice for accounting.

I’ve cc'ed Marissa for operational acceptance and David for billing flow. Which approach will work on your side? If procurement needs it in writing, we can circulate the short amendment today.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai
Direct: 415-555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@nimblecare.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-23T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and interim access ask

On Wed, Jul 22, 2025 at 10:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Option A — temporary seat swap (preferred):
> - We grant 2 additional seats for 14 days under the existing pilot scope.
> - No changes to the SOW; seats auto-revoke after 14 days.
> - We’ll send a one-line amendment for procurement to confirm (no legal signature required).

Hi Lina — operational note: we can provision the seats within 2 business hours once procurement confirms the amendment text. For the amendment, suggested language: "Redwood will temporarily add 2 seats to the NimbleCare pilot for a period of 14 days starting on the date of provisioning; these seats will automatically expire and will not change the total contracted pilot value."

If procurement prefers the voucher route, we’ll issue a $3k credit code which procurement can redeem and apply against the pilot invoice. Either way, no SLA or scope expansion — purely runway to support the demo.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-seat-swap-amendment.docx (docx)]

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@nimblecare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimblecare.com
Date: 2025-07-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and interim access ask

Evelyn / Marissa — procurement approves Option A (temporary seat swap).

Please go ahead and provision the 2 seats tomorrow morning. Procurement will accept the one-line amendment in the email body (no countersign). I’ll share the billing contact for tracking, but confirm there will be no invoice change outside standard pilot billing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lina Torres
Head of Platform Success — NimbleCare
